title: Returned-Payment Fee Levels by Number of Bank Returns: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Fee level.** The fee level of a returned-payment fee on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the bank returns on the agreement, counted as the payments reversed for insufficient funds or a closed account in the 12 months up to the handling date, with the return being charged included:

| Bank returns in the 12 months (the one being charged included) | Fee level |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $45 |
| 2 | $40 |
| 1 | the class's returned-payment fee |

## The class figure for a single return

| Unit class | Class's returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $30 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $30 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $30 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $30 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $35 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $35 |

The count is read from the agreement's ledger: payment reversal entries whose reason is insufficient funds or account closed, posted within the 12 months up to the handling date. Card chargebacks are not counted.

## Hypothetical cases

- A Bluegate Climate Plus tenant's first bank return of the year: level $30.
- The same tenant's second bank return in 12 months: level $40.
- A third return in 12 months, an earlier return having been a card chargeback: two bank returns are counted, so the level is $40.
- A Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault tenant with returns 2, 7 and 11 months ago and the one now being charged: four returns, level $45.
